The difference

I'm an FP&A leader who builds controlled finance workflows. The model needs to add up, but it also needs to show where each number came from, what is still a draft, and who has signed off.

In practice · Butler Finance

Butler Finance is a prototype I am building to put that approach into software. It brings departmental models and actuals into plan-versus-actual review, helps prepare reforecast drafts, and assembles executive and board reporting. Calculation stays separate from interpretation; changes and reporting pass through human review.

It is an example of how I design a finance workflow, not a client deployment or a product with claimed customer traction. I can walk through a sanitized example of the approach.
